title: UC San Diego Launches ARPA-H Project to 3D Bioprint Patient-Specific Human Livers
summary: UC San Diego researchers are leading a $25.8 million ARPA-H–funded effort to 3D bioprint patient-specific, transplantable human livers, aiming to eliminate organ shortages and improve outcomes for liver failure patients.The postUC San Diego Launches ARPA-H Project to 3D Bioprint Patient-Specific Human Liversappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
